scope: Independent synthetic offline tests of selection_rule.py only

findings.title: Duplicate frozen inputs and review cases accepted
findings.detail: A seven-row manifest with six unique IDs passes; appending a second review of case-a yields duplicate planned cases instead of rejection.
findings.verified_fix: Checks exact six manifest rows and IDs; requires exactly two unique review case IDs matching the manifest case set.

findings.title: Case-level short circuits bypass score validation
findings.detail: NaN on a status-ok row is accepted when a sibling fails or the whole case is quality-rejected. Failed and unavailable rows also accept numeric values, and unknown statuses are treated as unavailable.
findings.verified_fix: Validates every row status and score before any case-level skip; non-ok scores must be null and unknown statuses are rejected.

findings.title: Decimal 0.01 boundary rounds below dispatch threshold
findings.detail: Saved JSON values 0.03 and 0.02 subtract to a float slightly below 0.01; the selector marks this below_local_threshold. Use Decimal on saved decimal values for the threshold comparison.
findings.verified_fix: Compares Decimal(str(before)) - Decimal(str(after)) against Decimal("0.01"), then emits the delta as float.

findings.title: Quality gate uses only factual verdict
findings.detail: Answers with acceptable=false or qualifications_pass=false remain in the passing set. A correct preference list excluding those answers is rejected; an unsafe preference list including them is accepted. Missing acceptable verdict also passes.
findings.verified_fix: Requires explicit boolean factual_pass, acceptable and qualifications_pass; only their conjunction enters the passing set.

passing_contracts: Inferior ranked text cannot win on a low local score
A failed alternative marks the whole quality-ready case unavailable
Missing, duplicate and unexpected local record IDs rejected
Quality review and input manifest exact bytes frozen between phases
Actual input hashes and local manifest/input hashes verified before selection
review_receipt_state: Independent post-fix inspection, all 26 synthetic tests and focused Ruff passed.

final_run.fixtures: Temporary synthetic six-input/two-case packets only; no real prospective content or metrics.

assessment: No unresolved actionable findings in the bounded selection-rule review. Checks support this two-case/six-output selector contract, not detector validity, prose quality, or future GPTZero agreement.
